articles.title: Rathbones Group Is Just One Of 3 British Dividend Stocks
articles.summary: European natural gas prices are climbing to four year highs and the UK is bracing for some of the steepest household energy bills in Europe. That kind of squeeze pushes many people to look for their money to work harder, without taking wild swings on high growth stories. Reliable UK dividend payers yielding above 3% can help do that. This article walks through three of the strongest candidates from that shortlist. The three stocks highlighted here offer a compelling starting point if you want...
